text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hm? My hands feel kind of dry... And a 
little itchy, too...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
! Come to think of it, Inari said that dry 
skin makes you itchy...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Still, how do you make the itching go away 
again?

Twin Turbo couldn't stop worrying about 
the itchiness from her rough skin...
